title: Budget Analysts
description: Examine budget estimates for completeness, accuracy, and conformance with procedures and regulations. Analyze budgeting and accounting reports.

tasks.text: Analyze monthly department budgeting and accounting reports to maintain expenditure controls.
Review operating budgets to analyze trends affecting budget needs.
Perform cost-benefit analyses to compare operating programs, review financial requests, or explore alternative financing methods.
Match appropriations for specific programs with appropriations for broader programs, including items for emergency funds.
Summarize budgets and submit recommendations for the approval or disapproval of funds requests.
Direct the preparation of regular and special budget reports.

clusters.label: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Provide advice and technical assistance with cost analysis, fiscal allocation, and budget preparation.
Compile and analyze accounting records and other data to determine the financial resources required to implement a program.
Examine budget estimates for completeness, accuracy, and conformance with procedures and regulations.

clusters.label: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Consult with managers to ensure that budget adjustments are made in accordance with program changes.
Interpret budget directives and establish policies for carrying out directives.
Testify before examining and fund-granting authorities, clarifying and promoting the proposed budgets.
Seek new ways to improve efficiency and increase profits.

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
skills.def: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem. Examples: Microsoft Access, Online analytical processing OLAP software, Relational database software, Structured query language SQL.

skills.name: Enterprise resource planning ERP software
skills.def: Software to integrate, monitor, or analyze data from multiple business operations within a unified system. Examples: Adaptive Planning, Budgeting, forecasting, and planning software, Business performance management BPM software, Everest Software Advanced.

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: Email software, Microsoft Outlook.

skills.name: Business intelligence and data analysis software
skills.def: Software to present, visualize, or analyze data to help businesses make informed decisions. Examples: IBM Cognos Business Intelligence, Microsoft Power BI.

skills.name: Presentation software
skills.def: Software to create presentations, speeches, or slideshows. Examples: Microsoft PowerPoint, SAP Crystal Xcelsius.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.
